scale.absent: The domain is not part of the requested deliverable.
scale.supporting: The domain affects the deliverable, but success is mainly judged elsewhere.
scale.central: The deliverable would fail its main acceptance criteria if this domain were done poorly.

domains.description: Write or change executable software, scripts, APIs, integrations, or configuration.
Find causes of software or system defects or incidents and verify a repair. Ordinary creative revisions are outside this domain.
Design or run software/system tests, audit behavior, review code, or check an implementation against a specification. Ordinary source fact checking belongs to research.
Design component boundaries, data flows, interfaces, infrastructure, or a technical migration.
Deploy, release, configure, monitor, or operate a running system and its automation.
Assess or implement security, privacy, authentication, authorization, or abuse controls.
Deliver a sourced synthesis, comparison, or factual investigation of external or repository information. Routine code reading during implementation or review is outside this domain.
Calculate, analyze data, model uncertainty, or draw statistical conclusions.
Reason through explicit scientific, mathematical, or engineering concepts beyond routine arithmetic. Visual depiction of physical objects alone is outside this domain.
Define product goals, requirements, priorities, tradeoffs, or acceptance criteria.
Design game mechanics, levels, progression, balance, or player learning and engagement.
Design the visible layout, typography, colors, iconography, or visual hierarchy of an interface.
Design user journeys, controls, information architecture, accessibility, or interaction behavior.
Create or direct illustration, concept art, graphic assets, textures, or game visual style.
Create or reason about 3D models, geometry, rigging, spatial composition, or physical form.
Create or direct motion, poses, keyframes, timing, or transitions.
Create, edit, select, or evaluate sound, music, speech, or audio behavior.
Write or edit general prose, copy, narrative, or communication for a human audience. Technical instructions and specifications belong to documentation.
Translate or adapt language and cultural context while preserving intended meaning and voice.
Write instructions, specifications, or explanatory reference material for a system or process. Visual reference images alone are outside this domain.
